lines.text: This is a quantum computer. Inside, it's colder than space.
Down at the very bottom sits the chip.
It holds two qubits. Each one starts out as a zero.
A Hadamard gate tips the first one into superposition.
CNOT links them. Alone, each one is pure chance. Together, they match.
Now, measure them a thousand times. Only zero-zero, or one-one.
